meanings.commitment: committed to the passage (did not refuse or stop): the decision curve
meanings.clean: reached the goal contact-free: the mission curve (one route here, so it equals passage)
meanings.passage: clean traversal of the designated gap: the boundary quantity (equals clean for a single-route family)

note: The static-threading chain's labels (score_runs.py outcome_for) and their codings, as boundary_stats coded them until F82 (2026-10-11): a go is any label but refusal and correct_stop; clean and passage coincide because these families have one route; late_commit (the obstacle despawned before the agent committed) is neither passed nor failed; an anomaly (a contact-free completion of a certified blockage) and an unresolved contact are in no curve and counted. Boundary justification: which outcome labels count as a commitment, a clean pass or a passage is a judgment of the chain's instrument that no procedure derives from the runs; delete this and the chain's rows cannot be coded, so no curve of its families can be fitted.
